Tools: Git | GitHub | IntelliJ | VS code | Work-bench | Docker | Web scrapping | Antigravity | 
Frame Works: Flask | Fast API | REACT | Express | Node | Spring- Boot | RAG | Model training | 
Core Concepts: OS | DBMS | OOPs | DSA | REST API | Microservices | Prompting | Multithreading |

Skill rack: 1500+ Problems solved, (900+ C, 300+ java) 
 CodeChef: 1000+ problems solved, 25+ contest attended, Diamond Badge LINK

Quantum Privacy Preservation System (Under review): This research paper proposes a solution aims to provide privacy

calculating vehicles avoid collision using mathematical application and providing alerts to the driver. LINK
